headline: 260 newborn birth-anomaly cases in first 9 months of 2026, surpassing 184 in all of 2022
dek: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- Gaza Health Ministry, via undeclared carrier] Gaza's Health Ministry said Friday that 260 cases of congenital anomalies were recorded among newborns in the first nine months of 2026, surpassing the 184 cases documented throughout 2022, and called for an independent…
sources: Gaza Health Ministry, Director-General Munir al-Bursh
fault_line: 260 babies born with anomalies in nine months -- war's hidden toll, or numbers that need an independent investigation first? The ministry itself says the figures alone don't prove a cause.

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- Gaza Health Ministry, via undeclared carrier] Gaza's Health Ministry said Friday that 260 cases of congenital anomalies were recorded among newborns in the first nine months of 2026, surpassing the 184 cases documented throughout 2022, and called for an independent international investigation into the possible causes. Al-Bursh described the figures as 'a serious health warning', citing the war, hunger, displacement and the collapse of healthcare. [MINISTRY'S OWN CAUTION, INCLUDED] The ministry cautioned that the figures alone do not establish the prevalence of congenital anomalies among newborns or determine their causes. [CONTEXT] Same report restates the recorded toll: as of Thursday, Israeli violations of the ceasefire had killed 1,602 Palestinians and wounded 5,799 since Oct 2025 (matches the 1,602 figure recorded Nov 6); ~90% of Gaza's civilian infrastructure destroyed; 600 aid trucks/day expected under the agreement vs restricted entry. No new verified Gaza toll in-window; the 1,580 figure in the AJ Oct-31 mirror conflicts with the recorded 1,602 -- do not re-record (see triage 0900-09).
sections.what_verified: No declared-tier corroboration. Turkiye Today is UNDECLARED in the source registry -- attribution only, never counts. Gaza Health Ministry is the primary source for its own hospital data but is carried only through the undeclared family, so primary_source_single_family cannot be claimed under the registry rule (same treatment as 0800-02).
